summary: Printed zeros (METHODOLOGY decision 6) added for four sources: 17,907 monthly and quarterly zero cells of the IRCC Investor rows by citizenship, 475 of the IRCC Investor rows by province, none for the UK extensions datasets (record lists with no zero cells), and 544 for the Malta OR-GCES 2021 report (Tables 22-23 by locality, Appendix A 2021 column dashes, zero-labelled chart months). Every new row is value 0, reading digits, in the same tables, breakdowns, periods, units and status as the existing rows.

ledger.contains: IRCC open data workbook EN_ODP-PR-CitzImmCat (admissions of permanent residents by country of citizenship and immigration category, January 2015 to July 2026, monthly, quarterly and yearly). Only the Investor category is in scope (federal and Quebec investors combined; not split by programme). 114 countries/groups have an Investor row (including "Stateless"; "United Kingdom and Overseas Territories" mapped to GBR; "Palestinian Authority (Gaza/West Bank)" to PSE; "Hong Kong SAR" and "Macau SAR" kept separate from CHN). Taken: every yearly cell of every Investor row (including printed zeros) and every monthly and quarterly cell, printed zeros included (the 17,907 monthly and quarterly zeros added in pass extract-zeros-a); "--" (1 to 4) recorded as a range 1-4. The 105 yearly rows already in the data were not repeated. All other categories (skilled workers, family, refugees, entrepreneurs, etc.) are out of scope. The Investor rows have no blank cells (every month, quarter and year to July 2026 is printed as a number, 0 or "--"). The sheet does carry an all-countries Investor row in the category-summary block after "Zimbabwe - Total" (e.g. 2015 Total 5,460); it is not recorded (no breakdown, outside the by-country scope). The country rows add up to slightly less than it each year (2015: 5,415 counting "--" as 0, with 13 "--" cells), consistent with "--" cells and IRCC rounding to 5. Zero rows add nothing to any sum; a zero quarter or year always has zero months.

IRCC open data workbook EN_ODP-PR-ProvImmCat (admissions of permanent residents by province/territory of intended destination and immigration category, January 2015 to July 2026, monthly, quarterly, yearly). Investor rows exist for Quebec (Quebec Investor Program), Ontario, Alberta and British Columbia (federal programme tail); no Canada-wide Investor total. Taken: every yearly cell of the four Investor rows (including printed zeros after the federal cases ran out) and every monthly and quarterly cell, printed zeros included (the 475 monthly and quarterly zeros of the Ontario, Alberta and British Columbia rows added in pass extract-zeros-a; the Quebec row has no zero cells); "--" recorded as 1-4. The 22 yearly rows already in the data were not repeated. Other categories are out of scope. The Investor rows have no blank cells. A zero quarter or year always has zero months.

Extensions detailed datasets, year ending June 2026. Data_Exe_D01: grants and refusals of extensions of stay by quarter, nationality, applicant type (main/dependant) and category, 2010 Q1-2026 Q2; the Investor subgroup has 2,896 non-zero cells (2010 Q1-2025), all now taken (2,661 grants as residence_permits_renewed, 235 refusals as residence_renewals_refused). Data_Exe_D02: grants to main applicants by current and previous category of leave, 2015-2025: Investor renewals (previous Investor, 2015-2024) were already in the data; now added the 66 rows of in-country switches into Investor by previous category (incl. 2025, previous 'Unknown', 58) and the 26 rows of Investor holders switching to other categories 2015-2020 (new indicator programme_switches_out). Pivot sheets Exe_D01/Exe_D02 repeat the data sheets. All other categories (other routes) are out of scope. No printed totals for Investor in the data sheets, so no sum check was possible. Zero cells: the data sheets are record lists that print only non-zero combinations (no cell in Data_Exe_D01 or Data_Exe_D02 is 0, "-" or blank), so there are no printed zeros to record; a nationality, quarter or category missing from the sheet means no record, not a printed zero. The pivot sheets print zeros only for all-category totals, outside the Investor scope.

Eighth annual report of the Regulator (OR-GCES), June 2022, 60 pages, covering calendar 2021. Foreword; Section 1 (regulator\u2019s activities): vetting of 198 IIP applications (110 concluded, 75 refused, 13 withdrawn; agents\u2019 performance; documentation, timelines, due diligence; FIAU: 11 cases reported, 36 collaborated), 16 requests for review (69 since launch), Gazette (28 Dec 2021), media, parliamentary questions, the EP study, two court cases (judgments 25 Jun and 20 Oct 2020), retention policy. Section 2 (IIP statistics, calendar years 2015-2021): applications received per year and by month, sex, region, citizenships, dependants per year; approvals and not-approved per year and month, not-approved by region and rate; naturalised main applicants per year and month, dependants per year, by region (counts 2021, shares by year), employment, education, age; properties purchased/leased per year and by locality (Tables 22-23), their value (Tables 24-25); stocks per year; contributions per year, distributions in 2021 and since launch, suspense; fees; donations per year and by entity (Appendix A, 147 entities). Section 3 (2020 scheme): 75 eligibility applications (monthly chart), EUR 2,680,000 deposits, fees, 79 licensed agents by profession, complaints (none); merit route (8 applications, out of scope as not investment-based). Appendix B: salient points of L.N. 437 of 2020 (prices already in program_terms; caps of 400 a year and 1,500 in total described only). Existing rows kept (Tables 2, 10, 12, the 75 eligibility applications, EUR 2,680,000). Appendix A amounts recorded per entity with breakdown category=recipient_<name> (a new use of the category key; donation counts in notes). Tables 22-23 add up to their printed totals. Printed zeros: every printed 0 or "-" in the tables taken is now a row (pass extract-zeros-a added 263 zero cells of Table 22, 162 of Table 23, the 107 entities printed "-" in Appendix A's 2021 column, and the 12 zero-labelled months of Charts 1, 7, 9, 11 and 29; the zeros of Tables 5, 6, 16, 18, 20 and 29 were already in). No table taken has blank cells. Monthly charts are images: values read by OCR and accepted only where they match the bar height. Not recorded because no indicator fits: agents\u2019 performance, FIAU referrals, requests for review, documentation shares, merit-route figures.
